svg.text: Figure 6 — Casey's three stances on quantum, and the inversion
The corpus contains three distinct stances, operating at different levels. The inversion honors all three.
Stance 1: Mechanical disclaimer
Rhetorical level
"It is not a quantum curio dressed up for a philosophy essay.
It is a mechanical fact about the system." — OBSERVER_EFFECTS.md
Rejects metaphorical dressing-up. Does NOT refute stances 2 or 3.
Stance 2: Formal QM engagement
Formal level
U(θ) = e^(-iθH), projection operators, Schrödinger evolution,
fiber bundle / holonomy / curvature, spectral triple, noncommutative torus.
— paper-207, quilt-id README. Stated in essays; not implemented in runtime code.
Stance 3: Metaphorical vocabulary
Imaginative level
"Quantum Scarring", "Entanglement Cascade", "Quantum Leakage" —
explicitly LLM-generated imaginative terms from a writers'-room exercise.
— paper-225, Tier 3 "Filed for later". Explicitly not technical claims.
THE INVERSION (the user's contribution)
Quilt is NOT quantum, does not implement BQP, does not produce quantum outputs — and yet reaches the same epistemic regime
(verifiable expectation values from forward-and-backward comparison) through different mathematics.
Honors stance 1 (accepts the disclaimer) + stance 2 (engages the formalism as vocabulary) + stance 3 (treats imaginative terms as labels).
